Rae (People Ops): Heads-up: All-hands tomorrow 9:30am PT. Please drop 1-2 line agenda bullets or questions by tonight EOD. We will record and post slides.

Anya (CEO): I'll open with a short strategy note and two priorities for the quarter.

Lee (Product): I'll demo Dedicated autopilot (8m) and outline canary timing. tagging @Jon for runtime notes.

Jon (Eng): I'll cover two quick engineering callouts: batching default update and the debug-log retention policy change for Dedicated customers (short blurb).

Mira (Platform): I'll show a p95 chart (KV cache results) and note early quantization work.

Rae (People Ops): Draft agenda: 9:30 intro (Anya), 9:36 Product demo (Lee), 9:44 Eng callouts (Jon), 9:52 Platform metrics (Mira), 9:58 Q&A, 10:10 Close + TL;DR. Keep bullets short.

Lee (Product): infra/plat on standby for Qs? @Jon @Mira

Jon (Eng): confirmed. quick pasteable for Q&A:
``
redwoodctl config get batching
redwoodctl diagnose inference --tail=50
``

Rae (People Ops): Policy note for slides: default debug-log retention shortened to 30 days; Dedicated customers may request extensions via support.

notify-bot: Calendar invite -> https://calendar.example.com/event/5160000123 (Zoom link in invite).

(After meeting) notify-bot: Recording + slides posted -> https://videos.example.com/recordings/5160000123 and https://drive.example.com/5160000123-slides.pdf

Rae (People Ops): Post-meeting TL;DR: Autopilot canary next week (owners in follow-up doc), retention default = 30 days (Dedicated exceptions via support), console dark-mode opt-in live, p95 down ~17% after KV cache. Follow-ups and owners in shared doc.

Anya (CEO): Thanks team  great cross-team work and solid customer momentum.
